highlights_headline: The upcoming release pairs HarfBuzz 15.0.0 with expanded named script coverage in HarfBuzzSharp.
highlights_body: Thirty additional Script fields include Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing script values, parsing and numeric conversions remain unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled native library and moves HarfBuzzSharp and its NativeAssets packages to version 15.0.0. The HarfBuzzSharp assembly version remains 1.0.0.0.

bullets.lead: Named constants for every bundled script
bullets.detail: Adds 30 static readonly Script fields, bringing named coverage to 179 native script tags. The existing struct-based API, all 149 prior fields and their values, parsing, conversions and horizontal-direction lookup are preserved.
